sub_graphs.title: Altair: Light Client Gossip Protocol
sub_graphs.description: Models the gossip pubsub topics for distributing light client updates across the P2P network

nodes.label: New Finality Update Available
nodes.description: A new LightClientFinalityUpdate has been produced by a full node

nodes.label: Publish Finality Update to Gossip
nodes.description: Broadcast LightClientFinalityUpdate on the light_client_finality_update gossip topic

nodes.label: Validate Finality Update
nodes.description: Check that slot exceeds all previously forwarded updates (or matches with supermajority), verify propagation delay, and validate cryptographic signatures

nodes.label: Finality Update Accepted
nodes.description: Update passed validation and is forwarded to subscribed peers and local light client logic

nodes.label: Finality Update Rejected
nodes.description: Update failed validation checks; dropped and not forwarded

nodes.label: New Optimistic Update Available
nodes.description: A new LightClientOptimisticUpdate has been produced

nodes.label: Publish Optimistic Update to Gossip
nodes.description: Broadcast LightClientOptimisticUpdate on the light_client_optimistic_update gossip topic

nodes.label: Validate Optimistic Update
nodes.description: Check that attested header slot exceeds prior updates, verify propagation time, validate signature and consistency with finality data

nodes.label: Optimistic Update Accepted
nodes.description: Optimistic update passed validation; forwarded to peers

nodes.label: Optimistic Update Rejected
nodes.description: Optimistic update failed validation; dropped

sub_graphs.title: Altair: Light Client Update Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation logic applied to incoming gossip messages for light client updates

nodes.label: Light Client Update Received
nodes.description: An update (finality or optimistic) has been received from a gossip peer

nodes.label: Check Slot Freshness
nodes.description: Verify that the update slot exceeds all previously forwarded updates for this topic

nodes.label: Check Supermajority Participation
nodes.description: If slot matches highest seen, verify supermajority sync committee participation

nodes.label: Check Network Propagation Timing
nodes.description: Verify message received with sufficient network propagation delay from slot start

nodes.label: Verify Cryptographic Signature
nodes.description: Validate the sync committee BLS aggregate signature on the update

nodes.label: Update Passes All Checks
nodes.description: Update has passed freshness, timing, and cryptographic validation

nodes.label: Update Dropped
nodes.description: Update failed one or more validation checks; not forwarded

edges.label: First check: is update newer than seen?
Same slot as highest; check participation

external_entities.name: Gossip Message Sender
external_entities.description: Peer that sent the light client update via gossip

ambiguities.text: 'sufficient network propagation delay' is not precisely quantified
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume propagation delay is computed from slot start time using a configured fraction of the slot duration (likely SECONDS_PER_SLOT / 3 or similar).

ambiguities.text: 'supermajority participation' threshold for allowing same-slot replacement is not explicitly defined
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume supermajority means >= 2/3 of sync committee members participated, consistent with other Ethereum consensus thresholds.

implicit_assumptions.description: Light clients trust that the sync committee signatures represent honest majority of the current sync committee
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A corrupted sync committee could sign invalid headers, causing light clients to follow a false chain

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot produce valid BLS aggregate signatures for the sync committee without controlling committee members' keys
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Forged sync committee signatures would allow feeding light clients arbitrary finalized/optimistic headers

implicit_assumptions.description: Full nodes serving light client data have access to recent finalized state and can produce valid bootstrap/update responses
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Light clients could receive stale or incomplete data, failing to sync properly
